Chelsea loanee and Argentine forward Alejandro Garnacho has removed all references to Aston Villa from his Instagram profile amid growing uncertainty over his future at the Premier League club. The 22-year-old is currently on loan at Villa Park from Chelsea but has struggled for playing time under manager Unai Emery. As reported by talkSPORT, Garnacho’s situation attracted attention on Wednesday after football fans noticed that he had deleted every mention of Aston Villa from his Instagram page, which has more than 10 million followers. The former Manchester United forward is yet to start a match for Villa since arriving in July and has managed just 95 minutes of football across competitions. His situation reportedly worsened on Tuesday night when Emery left him out of the matchday squad for the third consecutive game in all competitions. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. UCL: Man City extend winless run with 2-2 Napoli draw Lampard sweats over Awoniyi’s ankle injury Bassey happy at Fulham amid contract talks Garnacho’s limited involvement has raised questions about his future at the club, with Chelsea potentially facing an awkward situation when the loan spell ends. Chelsea were reportedly hoping to recoup around £42 million from the deal, but the winger’s lack of playing time could complicate the arrangement. Garnacho’s Instagram profile still features several references to Manchester United and Argentina, while his FA Cup triumph with United remains pinned to the top of his page. The development has also drawn comparisons with Harvey Elliott’s difficult loan spell at Aston Villa from Liverpool during the 2025/26 season. Elliott was reportedly frozen out to avoid triggering an obligation to buy clause linked to the number of appearances he made. Meanwhile, former England midfielder Danny Murphy has reacted to Garnacho’s situation, insisting that the winger’s exclusion from the team is not related to his footballing ability.
